name: DaSiWa LTX 2.3: DragonLeap v4 (distilled)
author: Darksidewalker
note: His distilled LTX 2.3 line (DMD), fp8, in one file: CFG 1 with euler_cfg_pp and LTX's own schedule (he gives 8 to 10 steps), no distilled LoRA on top; the form reads that from the name. Image-to-video and video-to-video first, with sound. LTX's own VAE (the audio one) and text encoder are the official files. Rechecked against his page on 5 October 2026: DragonLeap v4 is his newest distilled; the page also has GGUF and nf4 copies for smaller cards.
